blurb: Guests can take narrated sightseeing tours such as the Old Town Trolley Tour and Conch Tour Train, explore haunted sites on the Ghosts and Gravestones Trolley, and enjoy water sports adventures including snorkeling and parasailing. Attractions include the Key West Aquarium, Harry S. Truman Little White House, Butterfly Conservatory, and Shipwreck Treasure Museum.
